sentences.text:
The learned A.G.P.
waives service of notice on behalf of Respondent Nos.1 to 5.
2.

Considering the controversy that the Respondents claim that the road was already existing and the Petitioners claim that road has been widened, and being a public project, we would not stay the execution of the project.

However, even at this interim stage, we make it clear that, if we come to a conclusion 7042.24wp that any parcel of land belonging to any of the Petitioners, has been utilized for the public project, we would direct initiation of an appropriate proceeding for payment of compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
